> /cc @Defined2014 @zimulala

What's the propose for this PR? Does it related with the concurrent DDL or just code clean?

> > /cc @Defined2014 @zimulala
> 
> What's the propose for this PR? Does it related with the concurrent DDL or just code clean?

for concurrent DDL, also code clean. 

in previous, the job ctx is maintained by worker, which means this worker can not run another job before the current job has been done, the concurrent DDL cannot guarantee it. In concurrent DDL, a job can be run by different workers.

Also, it is not reasonable for DDL worker to maintain it.
This pull request has been accepted and is ready to merge. <details>Commit hash: 92a96f140a4d08d44fbfe24c6f250b4cd2a9309b</details>

> In concurrent DDL, a job can be run by different workers.

@xiongjiwei I'm currently editing the DDL code for some resources tracing, and have a question about your design. You mentioned a job could be run by different workers, that makes sense, and can I have another conclusion that a worker can only process one ddl job? If so, I'm going to add the [`JobContext`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/738f681d6110c0e0ee50a412a0f54d977e1574f5/ddl/ddl_worker.go#L100-L107) into backfillers.
@you06 yes, a worker can only process one ddl job at a time.

issue_context.title: jobCtx should not maintained by worker

review_comments: Why take a job state as the unit to make a worker schedule? It needs a lock. How about using a job as the unit?
